name: Tunisia
famous_for: Ancient Carthage ruins, Star Wars desert sets in Matmata & Tataouine, blue-and-white Sidi Bou Said cliff village, and El Djem amphitheatre.
tourists: Over 9.4M visitors; famous for El Djem Roman amphitheatre, Bardo mosaic museum, Medina of Tunis, and Djerba island synagogues.
must_know: Sidi Bou Said's famous blue-and-white architectural code was established by Baron Rodolphe d'Erlanger in the 1920s.
fun_fact: El Djem's Roman amphitheatre could hold 35,000 spectators and is one of the best-preserved imperial amphitheatres in the Mediterranean.
